# OpenProgram 0.6.5 Release Notes

Original version date: August 15, 2026. This tag fixed the Intel macOS Desktop architecture mapping, but final asset verification still failed. It did not publish installable assets.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- Mapped the Intel macOS runtime architecture `x86_64` to electron-builder's `x64` value.
- Enabled the Intel macOS Desktop build to consume the matching platform runtime.

## ⚠️ Release status

- The complete Desktop runtime check could not parse the formatted `runtime-manifest.json`.
- No GitHub Release or installable runtime assets were published.
- This tag is not an installable user version; `v0.6.6` fixed the remaining issue and completed the formal release.

## 🔄 Version guide

- Previous release attempt: [`v0.6.4`](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/tag/v0.6.4)
- Installable version: [`v0.6.6`](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/tag/v0.6.6)
